decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, Cobalt savings earn an extra 0.25 points on balances up to $50,000. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.75 points, on balances up to $50,000. We have added 50 support staff for the coming weeks.

decisions.message: Thank you for your patience in recent weeks. For the next 4 weeks, new money you add to Cobalt savings earns an extra 0.5 points, on balances up to $50,000. For the next 8 weeks, if you dispute a card charge we credit up to $100 right away. Paychecks paid into Cobalt can now show up to 2 days early.
